title: Tools
content:
Small browser-based tools. Each one is a standalone app that stores its data locally in your browser (no account, no server) - data won’t sync across devices.
Vocabulary Trainer - practice English vocabulary. LeetCode Guardian Tracker - checklist of Hard problems by pattern for Guardian badge prep.
